thread:
alex.cs: Heads up — ACME (org_id: org_8923) filed an escalation: their org-level latency dashboard lost p95/p99 lines after last night's telemetry ingest deploy. Screenshot attached by customer shows only avg/median traces. They say tenant-level view is fine.

carla-support: Thanks Alex. Ticket 46281. Do we have the deploy ID or can someone from infra confirm what changed in the ingest?

deploy-bot: deploy completed: telemetry-ingest-v2 -> canary -> 2024-04-10T03:12:00Z (commit: 9f1b7c).

maria-sre: I'm on it. Can you paste the org dashboard url and the time window the customer used? I want to check whether this is aggregation or label issue.

alex.cs: https://console.redwood.ai/org/org_8923/latency?slo=30d customer used 1h and org-scoped view. They reported it's showing avg/p50 only; p95/p99 series are missing (no zeros either).

jon-eng: Quick hypothesis — last deploy remapped percentile tag names in the collector. If percentiles are emitted as metric.percentile:0.95 vs metric.p95 label, org-level rollups might rely on the older tag. Can anyone run a query against raw metrics for org_8923?

observability-bot: query template:
```
metrics.search("metric_name:request_latency_percentile AND tags.org_id:org_8923 AND tags.percentile:0.95", "2024-04-10T02:00:00Z", "2024-04-10T04:00:00Z")
```

maria-sre: Running that now...

maria-sre: Result: 0 series found for tags.percentile:0.95. If I query metric_name:request_latency_percentile AND tags.p95:true I get hits. So deploy introduced a label rename from percentile->p95/p99 keys.

jon-eng: Ugh — we changed the collector output to emit dedicated tags (p95=true, p99=true) for downstream optimizations but forgot to update the rollup translator that builds org-level percentile series. Org rollups expect tags.percentile with numeric values.

carla-support: So tenant views show percentiles (they query p95=true locally) but org rollups that aggregate across tenants look for percentile numeric tag and therefore no aggregated p95/p99. That matches customer symptom.

ryan-esc: Need a mitigation ASAP. Can we patch the rollup transformer to accept both formats, or add a short-term compatibility step in the collector? Which is faster?

jon-eng: Fastest is to add a fallback in the rollup job: if no tags.percentile present, look for p95/p99 boolean flags and map them to numeric percentiles (0.95/0.99) during the aggregation phase. I'll open a hotfix PR.

maria-sre: Agreed. I'll also add an alert to catch when percentile-series count per-org drops below threshold to avoid silent regressions.

jon-eng: Hotfix PR: https://git.redwood.ai/ingest/rollup/merge_requests/478 — includes mapping and unit tests. Rolling to canary now.

deploy-bot: rollout started: ingest-rollup-hotfix MR-478 -> canary (2024-04-10T04:02:00Z)

maria-sre: Canary looks good for org_8923 — p95/p99 reappeared in org dashboard after rollup mapping applied.

carla-support: Noted. Carla to update ACME ticket 46281 with root cause and ETA for full rollout.

alex.cs: Customer notified, they confirmed p95/p99 lines returned for their org view. They want postmortem and timeline.

jon-eng: Next steps: backfill check for last 8 hours where percentile metrics were not aggregated at org-level (to avoid SLO gaps), full rollout in 30 minutes, and postmortem doc. I'll own the bugfix and postmortem.

carla-support: Thanks everyone — marking as resolved for the customer once full rollout completes. :thumbsup:

ryan-esc: Filing follow-up: add integration test that validates both percentile tag formats during ingest.

alex.cs: Closing loop: customer very appreciative of quick response. We'll include the rollback window and backfill progress in ticket notes.
